user.title: Select an RF transmitter
user.description: Choose the radio used to send Dooya commands at 433.890 MHz.

receiver.title: Select an optional RF receiver
receiver.description: Choose a receiver to learn the remote and observe physical button presses, or continue with manual setup. The receiver must already be tuned for your 433 MHz OOK remote.

retry.title: Remote not learned
retry.description: No confirmed Dooya press was received, or the receiver became unavailable. Retry with an available receiver, or enter the remote ID manually.

manual.title: Enter the remote ID
manual.description: Enter the ID of the remote already paired with your blinds.

data_description.remote_id: Full 28-bit remote ID (7 hex digits): e.g. 0x4231157 for playroom, 0x123C140 for a zero-prefix remote.

finish.title: Number of channels
finish.description: Enter the number of numbered channels (1–15). Channel 0 is All blinds. The upper nibble of the former channel byte belongs to the remote ID.

reconfigure.title: Change remote settings
reconfigure.description: Change the 28-bit remote ID, radios, or number of channels (1–15). Retained channels keep their entity IDs. Channel 0 is All blinds.

error.invalid_remote_id: Enter a 28-bit remote ID between 0 and 268435455, decimal or hexadecimal with a 0x prefix (e.g. 0x4231157).
error.invalid_channels: Enter a whole number of channels between 1 and 15.
error.invalid_transmitter: Select a compatible 433.890 MHz OOK transmitter.
error.receiver_unusable: Select an available receiver or continue without a receiver.
error.already_configured: Another Dooya entry already uses this 28-bit remote ID.

abort.no_transmitters: Add an RF transmitter to Home Assistant before setting up Dooya RF.
abort.no_compatible_transmitters: No RF transmitter supports 433.890 MHz with OOK modulation.

progress.listening: Press Stop on the physical remote. Listening for repeated Dooya frames for up to 30 seconds. Nothing is transmitted while learning.
